The woman is engaged in espionage work: she watches a cream utility van through the narrow window while assembling a contemporaneous field record. Inside, a long-lens camera rests firmly on a beanbag at the window, its optical axis aimed at that van. Its rear display shows a recently captured view of the same van. An open notebook immediately beside the camera contains a small printed image of that vehicle above fresh rows of pencilled observation marks. Her right forearm rests on the table, the pencil tip meeting the next row in the notebook; her left hand holds a wired radio microphone just below her mouth. . She sits squarely on a wooden stool, both feet on the floor, with her body beside the camera so the long lens has a clear route through the window.
